title: Army Sets Date for First Military Execution by Firing Squad Since 1945
summary: Maj. Nidal Malik Hasan, a former Army psychiatrist, will be shot to death on Dec. 3 at Fort Hood, where he killed 13 and wounded 32 in 2009.
